claim: No Monte Carlo evidence exists for the drawn TX/RX cells, and no analog statistical spec row is ratified. This is a declared gap, not evidence and not a pass.
reason: The ratified spec has no statistical row, and the tier doc does not allow a not_applicable outcome for an analog partition. ngspice 42 on the worker cannot load the OSDI v0.4 BSIM-CMG module, so no circuit simulation of the drawn cells exists (spec/decisions/0003-simulation-flow.md). Adding statistical rows would extend the ratified spec and is out of scope (spec/decisions/0008-item6-analog-declared-gap.md).
why_not_in_manifest: Tested on klt 0.8.0: a spec_rows "6.analog" declared_gaps row with no citation grades unmet / no_evidence, not partial_coverage, so the declaration changes nothing in the verdict. Same mechanism as item 5, tracked as 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#4190. This file is therefore not cited under evidence and is not content-hash bound.

owners.statistical_spec_rows: a future operator-ratified decision, if analog performance rows are added
owners.circuit_simulation: worker-spec change (ngspice 44 or later), per decision 0003
